items.title: Lionel Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, October 18, 1995
items.q: And so Sister Pietro was her name, and boy she was a great teacher.

ctx.x: I guess things haven’t changed that much today, you know?

That’s right. If you were on your side of the street, and another gang comes over, well you were lucky if you got home all right. But you see my grandmother wanted to see that I got an education and that I was always on the right side of the street. But as I tell you, at that time you were having gang fights in Chicago, so my grandmother picked out and inquired about a private school, and I was admitted there to a Catholic boy’s training school. And in the schooling, well first of all, this place that I went in…
Was she pretty strict with you?
